brief:
The post that tagged the bot says:
@buildthis.bisks.net on the main bisks.net page when there's code or italics for a description it renders that HTML literally instead of rendering the actual code as it should be presented, is there a chance you could fix that? also apply this to rateyourbuild too

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [link: https://bisks.net — bisks.net — atprotozoa — A little zoo of tiny atproto experiments.]
note: fixed it — descriptions were escaping their own <em>/<code> into literal text; bisks.net, rateyourbuild, and receipts now render <b>/<i>/<em>/<code> for real while still showing genuine <handle>-style brackets as plain text.
